title: Working Parents Struggle to Balance Work and Family Life
discussion_signal: Pew's relay highlights a gap between working parents' demand for paid leave and their actual access to it. Related discussion describes work-family conflict as a structural scheduling and childcare problem rather than simply an individual time-management failure.
linked_research_question: How do employer benefits, schedule flexibility, and childcare availability determine whether working parents can convert paid work into family stability?
